title: Spectrum TG36E Electric 4-Wheel Lawnmower 1600W
description_html:
Spectrum TG36E Electric Lawnmower – 1600W

Perfect for small urban, suburban and village gardens, the Spectrum TG36E is a lightweight, easy-to-use electric lawnmower designed to deliver a clean, precise cut with low noise levels and minimal maintenance.

With a practical 36cm cutting width, the TG36E combines excellent performance with outstanding value, offering features typically found on more expensive models.

A single-lever height adjustment system makes it quick and easy to choose from six cutting heights between 20mm and 70mm, allowing you to achieve everything from a closely cropped finish to a longer, healthier lawn. Its low 20mm minimum cutting height is among the lowest available on a rotary electric mower.

At the heart of the mower is a powerful 1600W brushless induction motor, providing dependable performance, quieter operation and an extended service life compared to conventional brushed motors. Being electrically powered, the TG36E also produces zero exhaust emissions and requires very little routine maintenance.

Clippings are collected in a durable 40-litre hard-top grass collector that is lightweight, easy to remove and simple to empty, reducing interruptions while you work.

Comfort and safety are built into the design, with ergonomic twin control levers providing a secure grip during operation. A safety blade brake system stops the blade within seconds of releasing the controls for added peace of mind.

Once mowing is complete, the upper handle folds down quickly for more compact storage and easier transportation. Large, smooth-rolling wheels ensure excellent manoeuvrability, while the generous 15-metre power cable provides plenty of reach for smaller gardens without the need for extension leads in many situations.

Please note that this machine requires some assembly before first use. Full instructions are included to guide you through the process, and the assembly is straightforward, requiring only basic tools to complete.
